description: Cite-or-abstain ledger for the wind NormCard corpus. Evidence items that failed the verification gate are listed under rejectedEvidence (none in the wind shard: all 24 records were verified against the consolidated CVDR704250 text). Topics for which NO provincial norm could be cited are recorded under abstentions — these must never appear as NormCards or FormalRules until a verified citation exists.
policy: cite-or-abstain: a legal claim becomes a NormCard only with instrument + article + version/date + verbatim quote + URL, all verified. Everything else is recorded here with a reason.

abstentions.topic: stikstof (nitrogen deposition) norms for wind turbines
abstentions.reason: The Omgevingsverordening provincie Utrecht contains no provincial nitrogen articles; nitrogen rules are national law. National instruments were not fetched in this recon run, so no citation exists — abstained.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: exclusion/assessment rule for nitrogen deposition near Natura 2000

abstentions.topic: general wind-turbine noise limits (dB) outside stiltegebieden
abstentions.reason: Wind-turbine noise limits outside the stiltegebied doelstellingen (art. 9.26) are set by national law (Wet geluidhinder / Besluit activiteiten leefomgeving); the verordening contains none. No provincial citation possible — abstained.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: noise contour rule around noise-sensitive buildings

abstentions.reason: The verordening regulates hub height (ashoogte) in art. 5.3 only; no provincial tip-height norm exists — abstained rather than derived.
No provincial setback (afstand) norm for wind turbines exists in the verordening; inventing one would violate cite-or-abstain.

The Natura 2000 and ganzenrustgebied exclusion (toelichting art. 5.4 + Omgevingsvisie) has NO provincial GIO in Bijlage II; geometry must come from national datasets via the geo analyst, with provenance caveats on the resulting ZoneResult.

The DSO Omgevingsdocumenten Downloaden API (service.omgevingswet.overheid.nl/publiek/omgevingsdocumenten/api/downloaden/v1) returned HTTP 401 'Inloggegevens ontbreken' — an API key is mandatory and none is available. GIO join-ids are therefore cited from the consolidated CVDR text (Bijlage II) only; geometry retrieval needs the key or open fallbacks with provenance caveats.
abstentions.wouldHaveBeen: authoritative geometry for every provincial_gio zoneSelector

abstentions.topic: province ArcGIS layer ET_wind_gebieden_windenergie as legal geometry
abstentions.reason: The ArcGIS layer ET_wind_gebieden_windenergie/13 is an energy-transition tracking layer ('meest kansrijke gebieden'), NOT the juridische GIO 'gebied windenergie' from Bijlage II. It must not be presented as the legal werkingsgebied; using it requires an explicit provenance-alias caveat.

A major amendment is expected: PS vaststelling 18-11-2026, inwerkingtreding 01-01-2027. Its rules are NOT current law; the corpus must re-run the legal recon before that date. Current CVDR snapshot is frozen for V3 reproducibility.
